map.：雨强 10 mm/h、持续 3 h → 降水量 30 mm；1 mm 降水=1: Intensity 10 mm/h for 3 h gives 30 mm of precipitation; 1 mm of rain means 1 L of water per m2, so a 100 m2 roof collects 3000 L.
map.：24h 降水 50–99.9 mm 暴雨、100–249.9 大暴雨、≥250: For 24h precipitation, 50-99.9 mm is rainstorm, 100-249.9 is extreme rainstorm and 250 or more is extraordinary rainstorm; here 30 mm is heavy rain.
